content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Earlier I shared some Excel files to help calculate GAIN and OFFSET for analog amplifiers. I'm now providing my updated version (with several bug fixes) along with an integrated factorization tool specifically for [product_name] amplifiers. I hope this will make programming with [product_name] simpler for you. Best regards, [user_name] Tip: The attachment includes all versions!

Hi, With the [product_name] series [article_no], you can compute linear functions (using amplifier blocks) and polynomial functions based on analog values Ax (using the Math function). Using Microsoft Excel to determine coefficients for polynomials of order 1 (linear) up to 4 or 5 is quite helpful. These coefficients are essential for configuring the parameters in a [product_name] circuit, which can then calculate polynomials—often as approximations for real data. Here is the link to the tool: Excel tool for polynomial regression supporting linear and nonlinear calculations Best regards, [user_name]
